_comment: Phase http_request_firewall_custom (WAF custom rules). Pro limit: 20 rules in this phase, no regex. apply.sh PUTs these rules FIRST and appends every existing rule whose description does not start with '[pro]' (e.g. 'Block secret-file scans'), so nothing already live is lost. Keys starting with '_' are stripped before sending.

rules.description: [pro] push API: known routes skip Super Bot Fight Mode
rules.expression: (http.host eq "push.artimer.win" and ((http.request.method eq "OPTIONS") or (http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/health" "/vapid-public-key"}) or (http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path in {"/subscribe" "/schedule" "/cancel" "/sync" "/test" "/unsubscribe"})))

(http.host eq "push.artimer.win" and not ((http.request.method eq "OPTIONS") or (http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/health" "/vapid-public-key"}) or (http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path in {"/subscribe" "/schedule" "/cancel" "/sync" "/test" "/unsubscribe"})))
(http.host in {"artimer.win" "www.artimer.win"} and not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/"))

((starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/")) or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "wp-" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/wordpress" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "xmlrpc" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "phpmyadmin" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/cgi-bin" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/vendor/" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/actuator" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/server-status" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/boaform" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/hnap1" or http.request.uri.path.extension in {"php" "php5" "php7" "phtml" "asp" "aspx" "jsp" "cgi" "pl" "env" "ini" "sql" "bak" "old" "swp" "yml" "yaml" "conf" "config" "log" "sh"})
